# Aria Quantum Language — API index

A small, readable DSL for quantum circuits on a pluggable pure-Rust runtime
(the vendored `omega-functions` engine). One source parses to a backend-agnostic
IR and then runs, trains (parameter-shift / adjoint gradients, no libtorch),
and exports to OPENQASM 2.0 / JSON / Lean 4. This file indexes the public Rust
entry points for embedding Aria as a library. Prose guide: docs/LIBRARY.md.
The default build needs no libtorch and no GPU.

## Start here
- docs/LIBRARY.md — "using Aria as a library": lower-once/bind-many, gradients, training (compiled snippets).
- crates/apps/qml-classifier — smallest end-to-end trained example (adjoint gradients through the Backend trait).
- TUTORIAL.md / GRAMMAR.md — the .aria language and CLI.
- README.md — overview; VERIFICATION.md — what each example proves.

## The core flow (3 crates)
- aria-core :: `ast::parse_aria(src) -> Program`; `Program::instantiate(name, &[(k,i64)]) -> Circuit`.
  `ast::qasm::to_qasm(&Circuit) -> String` (OPENQASM 2.0 export). `ast::GateKind` (incl. `RBS`).
- aria-runtime :: `lower::lower(&Circuit) -> Lowered { ir: CircuitIR, symbol_ids: HashMap<String,SymbolId>, .. }`.
  Binding-order contract on `Lowered`: SymbolIds are dense 0..N in first-appearance order (tested).
  `run::{expectation, statevector, run_counts}` — one-shot CLI-style wrappers (re-lower each call; not for loops).
  `run::expectation_with_gradient(circuit, obs, &bindings, sel, GradMethod, only: Option<&[&str]>) -> (f64, HashMap<String,f64>)` — name-keyed one-shot expectation + gradient (re-lowers; not for loops).
  `run::BackendSel::{Sim, Mps{chi}, MpsAuto{max_chi}, Gpu, Tch, PauliProp}` + `BackendSel::parse("mps:128" | "mps:auto" | "mps:auto:512")` (adaptive bond grows to a ceiling).
  `run::take_last_mps_stats() -> Option<MpsRunStats>` — truncation certificate of the last `run::*` MPS call (thread-local side channel; signatures unchanged).
  `train::{train_expectation, TrainConfig, Optimizer::{Gd,Adam}}` — single-observable variational trainer (VQE-shaped).
  `train_supervised::{train_supervised, SupervisedConfig, Loss::{Mse,Bce}, SupervisedResult}` — DATASET trainer:
    rows + labels + readout observable -> weights + affine head. Features are the symbols named `{feature_prefix}_*`
    (bound per row); everything else is trainable. Use this one for supervised/QML, not `train_expectation`.
  `model::{TrainedModel, ModelMetadata}` — `from_result` / `save` / `load` / `predict(&x, sel)`: self-contained
    trained-model JSON (weights + symbol order + head).
- omega-core :: the runtime types every backend and gradient path share.
  `executor::Backend` (trait): `expectation`, `expectation_multi` (batches OBSERVABLES),
    `expectation_batch` / `adjoint_gradient_batch` (batch ROWS: `&[&ParameterBinding]`, rayon-parallel on
    statevector, index-preserving), `adjoint_gradient`, `execute`.
  `executor::Observable::parse("0.5*X0 + Z1 Z2")`; `executor::PauliOp`.
  `circuit::{CircuitIR, GateOp, GateKind, ParamExpr, SymbolId=u32, Qubit}`.
  `params::ParameterBinding` — `new()`, `bind(SymbolId, f64)`; the typed parameter vector.
  `gradient::compute_gradient_for(backend, ir, binding, obs, &GradMethod, only: Option<&HashSet<SymbolId>>)`.
  `gradient::GradMethod::{Adjoint, ParameterShift, ParallelParameterShift, FiniteDifference}`.
  `parallel_shift::parallel_parameter_shift_gradient` — one-execution gradients for a trailing commuting block (arXiv:2606.03517).
  `qml::{QmlModel, QmlTrainer, Encoding, Optimizer}` — batched encode-then-ansatz trainer (MSE SGD/Adam).

## Backends (all impl omega_core::executor::Backend)
- omega-backend-statevector :: `StatevectorBackend::new()` — pure-Rust dense, exact, ≲24 qubits. Implements `adjoint_gradient`.
- omega-backend-mps :: `MpsBackend::new(chi)` — matrix-product-state, bond dim `chi` (2^(n/2) = exact).
  `MpsBackend::last_run_stats() -> MpsRunStats { discarded_weight, max_bond_reached }` — truncation certificate of the last run (0 = exact).
- omega-backend-pauliprop :: `PauliPropBackend` — Heisenberg-picture Pauli propagation; expectations only, width-unbounded on Clifford.
- omega-backend-pauli :: stabilizer tableau (Clifford).
- omega-backend-photonics :: Fock/optical modes (BeamSplitterRx, PhaseShifter).
- GPU (feature-gated): omega-backend-{statevector,mps,pauliprop}-{metal,cuda,opencl}.
- aria-backend-tch :: libtorch `tch::Tensor` statevector (feature `tch`, workspace-EXCLUDED; see INSTALL_LIBTORCH.md).

## Verification / apps
- aria-verify-core :: `harness::load_lowered(file, circuit, ints)` (repo examples/aria/), `harness::load_lowered_path(path, ..)` (arbitrary path).
  `harness::execute_report` (run through the wasm/native transport), `sim::forward_z_expectations(ir, params)` (independent oracle),
  `banner::*` (PASS/FAIL reporting), `data::{load_csv, ridge_regression, SplitMix64}` (vendored-dataset helpers).
- aria-verify :: `cargo run -p aria-verify -- all` runs every example harness vs its classical oracle (this is what CI asserts).
- crates/apps/<name> :: one crate per shipped example; each `pub fn run(Transport) -> Result<Verdict,String>`.

## CLI (crates/aria-cli, the `aria` binary)
- `aria run <f.aria> --circuit C [--int k=v] [--bind s=v] [--shots N] [--backend sim|mps[:chi]|mps:auto[:ceiling]|gpu|tch|pauliprop] [--statevector] [--expectation OBS] [--strict-truncation EPS]`
  (`mps:auto` grows the bond adaptively to a ceiling; an MPS run prints `mps: discarded_weight=… max_bond_reached=…` to stderr when it truncates, and `--strict-truncation EPS` fails if it exceeds EPS.)
- `aria train <f.aria> --circuit C --observable OBS [--steps N --lr R --opt adam --freeze a,b --set a=0.5 --grad parallel]` — single-observable trainer.
- `aria train <f.aria> --circuit C --data X.csv [--labels y.csv] [--loss mse|bce] [--feature-prefix x] [--save-model m.json]` — DATASET (supervised) trainer.
- `aria predict <model.json> --data X.csv [--out scores.csv] [--backend B]` — score rows with a saved model.
- `aria export <f.aria> --circuit C (--qasm|--json|--lean|--gate-model)`
- `aria list|parse <f.aria>`

## Server / remote (optional)
- omega-server :: HTTP execution service (`POST /v1/quantum/execute`, `POST /v1/quantum/expectation` (IR + binding + observable -> f64); PQC bearer auth). omega-client :: Rust client (`omega-client quantum execute|expectation`).

## Proofs
- proofs/lean4/QuantumProofs/*.lean :: sorry-free correctness theorems (Bell, QFT, QPE, Grover, HHL, QSVT, RBS gate).
